content.short: LooksRare is a decentralized NFT marketplace on Ethereum.
content.description: LooksRare is a decentralized NFT marketplace built on Ethereum, launched in January 2022 by Zodd and Guts. Users can list, buy, sell, stake and trade NFTs while earning rewards in LOOKS tokens. The platform provides a developer API to retrieve order data and interact with other smart contracts on the network. Its rewards program is designed to incentivize active participation and ongoing use of the marketplace by collectors, traders and creators.
